hero.name: Naji Alhusami

about.title: Building thoughtful software from interface to API.
about.body: I develop modern web applications with a focus on clear architecture, dependable performance and user-friendly interfaces. My background in Computer Engineering helps me work comfortably across frontend and backend concerns.
about.detail: I enjoy turning practical requirements into maintainable products using TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js and related technologies.

experience.title: Professional experience
experience.intro: Selected roles focused on building modern web interfaces, internal tools and reliable application workflows.

bullets: Developed internal dashboards with Retool and JavaScript, supported by PostgreSQL queries.
Built a Next.js and TypeScript web application using server-side rendering and REST API integrations.
Contributed to the Skip the Counter project and developed frontend features with Angular.
Worked on test automation using Cypress.
Collaborated with a Java and Spring Boot backend team.
Developed the Radar Technology application using React.js and TypeScript.
